Nina (People Ops): Dropping a tiny thread with copyable self-review + manager phrasing examples for teams. Use whatever fits and paste into your reviews. Link to kit: https://redwoodinference.docs/hr/selfreview-examples-2026
Carlos (Eng Manager): Love this. Can you include a few one-line manager comments we can copy into the form?
Nina (People Ops): Yep — copyable manager lines below. Also adding micro self-review starters for ICs and PMs.
Becca (PM): Please include PM-specific impact bullets. I always forget product metrics phrasing.
Nina (People Ops): Short micro-templates:

IC / Engineer self-review starter:
"What I shipped (2-4 bullets)
Quantified impact (p50/p99, cost delta, user metric) or proxy links
Major blockers & how I mitigated them
Next quarter focus + 1 dev skill goal
Support I need from my manager"

PM self-review starter:
"Feature summary (what shipped & why)
Outcome (metrics: adoption, retention, latency improvements)
Stakeholder work (cross-team coordination highlights)
Next quarter focus + 1 product growth goal
Support/decisions needed from manager"

Nina (People Ops): Manager phrasing examples (copy exactly):
- Exceeds: "Consistently delivered beyond expectations; shipped X which drove Y% improvement in Z. Evidence: link to dashboard. Suggested rating: Exceeds."
- Meets: "Delivered expected outcomes and collaborated effectively with runtime and product. Impact tracked in dashboard (link). Suggested rating: Meets."
- Needs Improvement: "Did not meet the agreed milestone this quarter. Blockers noted in the self-review; manager plan in place to address. Suggested rating: Needs Improvement."

Ibrahim (IC): Can you add example sentences for long-running research projects that had partial results?
Nina (People Ops): Research example lines:
- For IC: "Completed two experiments toward the research agenda; produced reproducible notebook and preliminary eval showing X% improvement on metric Y. Timeline extended due to compute constraints; next steps listed."
- Manager summary: "Work progressed on research milestones; partial outcomes achieved with documented next steps and mitigation plan. Recommended rating: Meets (with note on compute constraints)."

Carlos (Eng Manager): For calibration, what do we ask managers to record?
Nina (People Ops): Record: 1) date of calibration 1:1, 2) final suggested rating, 3) one-sentence evidence summary, 4) any context (leave, ramp, cross-team blocking). We added fields in the form for these.

Becca (PM): Anything special for mid-quarter hires?
Nina (People Ops): Hires <45 days: mark as "Ramp", set 1 onboarding goal + 1 small contribution. Managers note 90-day plan in the manager note.

Ibrahim (IC): Manager lines for coaching / development feedback?
Nina (People Ops): Copyable coaching lines:
- "Has shown strong growth in system design; recommended focus: ownership of end-to-end rollout."
- "Encourage more direct mentoring: suggest pairing sessions twice monthly; measurable: 3 mentees with logged outcomes."
